meta.title: Legalpad — Seed round, December 2026
meta.description: Seed pitch for Legalpad, a matter workspace that pins every open issue on a legal matter until it closes: problem, product, why now, traction, market, competition, model, team and a $4.5M ask.

slides.heading: No deadline on a legal matter gets lost again.
slides.lead: The matter workspace for law firms of 5 to 50 lawyers.
slides.notes: Say the sentence, pause, then name the round. Everything after this proves the sentence.

slides.heading: Small firms track open issues in email, and one in six slips
slides.body:
140 live matters per 12-lawyer firm.
30 to 60 open issues each, kept in inboxes and yellow pads.
slides.aside: 17% passed their due date unnoticed. Audit of 48 firms, 2025.

slides.heading: Legalpad pins every open issue to its matter until someone closes it
slides.lead: Each pin has one owner and one due date.
